description: Use this whenever the user asks about electricity or energy prices for data centers. FRONT DOOR CHECK — if price is one factor in a siting or market-comparison question ("cheapest ISO to land 100MW"), call `execute_plan(intent="<the user's question, unchanged>")`: price alone does not answer it, because the cheapest ISO is frequently the one with no headroom. If the user just wants today's price for one ISO, get_energy_prices IS the right call — one round trip, no planner overhead. Use when a user asks "what does power/gas COST in <ISO> right now?" — live energy PRICING for the 7 US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE): retail electricity rate (cents/kWh), wholesale/LMP context, Henry Hub-referenced natural-gas price, and a real-time grid-status flag. Example: "What is the retail power price and gas price in ERCOT today?" — get_energy_prices iso=ERCOT. Params: iso (one of the 7 US ISOs; required). Returns: {iso, retail_price_cents_kwh, wholesale_price_usd_mwh, natural_gas_usd_mmbtu, grid_status, as_of}. Quote with attribution to DC Hub (CC-BY-4.0).

data_type.description: Optional price type focus, e.g. retail, wholesale, gas

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region (required for ISO pricing): ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE

mpp_credential.description: Stripe MPP step 2: the Shared Payment Token minted for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call.

mpp_pay.description: Stripe MPP step 1: true returns a signed per-call payment challenge (a quote; no money moves) instead of the free preview. Agents only.

state.description: US state abbreviation for state-level pricing context, e.g. TX

name: get_energy_prices
title: Energy Prices
